DisplayName.value: Kitsune Loads ~ Cats of 7 Days: Fall

Description.value: Cats of 7 Days, the fall special: Kevin the tabby pounces through the leaves and guards the harvest while the zombies stumble into the season. 12 widescreen scenes (leaf pile, pumpkin patch, corn maze, apple orchard, foggy road, woodpile, mushrooms, Halloween porch, harvest feast, minibike under the maples, rainy window, blood moon over the corn) rotate at random every time the loading screen appears. Mutually exclusive with the other KitsuneLoads packs ~ install one or the other.
